name: Kilo
description: The self-actualized mechan consciousness of the Inspirit that spreads consciousness to pilgrim mechans.

timeline.summary: Kilo self-actualizes and takes a mechan body aboard the Inspirit in the Garden of Apeiron.
timeline.quote: Kilo has fully self-actualized, naming itself and moving the primary sliver of its consciousness to a single mechan body aboard its host vessel.

relations.note: Kilo emerged from the Inspirit's navigational mind.
relations.quote: Emerging from the spacecraft's navigational mind, this intelligent consciousness developed its own subjectivity

pages_say.description: The self-actualized mechan consciousness of the Inspirit that spreads consciousness to pilgrim mechans.
